checked_classes: Ordering errors — Identity confirmation precedes collector preparation and observations; attribution follows observations, independent review follows diagnosis, and Reflect follows Execute acceptance.

Missing dependencies — Tasks cover installed identity, bounded characterization, hypothesis assessment, remediation recommendations, and evidence review. Unavailable attribution is explicitly recorded without marking unresolved causal goals met.
Untestable acceptance criteria — Deliverables specify evidence fields, request counts, deadlines, size limits, stop conditions, skipped-operation records, and independent review.
Scope smuggling — Work remains confined to diagnostic artifacts, relevant source inspection, and bounded operational reads. Product fixes and unrelated lifecycle changes are explicitly excluded.
Constraint violations — Probes require subsequent Execute authorization; database record mutations, service interventions, product tests, inference requests, and dependency changes are prohibited.
Unsupported causal acceptance — The plan distinguishes client and server timing, identifies confounded explanations, requires counterevidence, and permits an explicitly inconclusive diagnosis.
